$comment: This file makes the repository itself a Claude Code plugin marketplace, so a teammate installs with two commands and gets updates with git pull. Keep it beside plugin.json. The marketplace NAME is the install namespace: plugins resolve as <plugin>@hmaheshwari1996.
name: hmaheshwari1996

metadata.description: A personal project: AI-assisted graphic design tooling that builds brand-compliant decks, videos and product CGI, and enforces each brand's guidelines automatically on every artifact.

plugins.name: brand-studio
plugins.description: Build enterprise decks, videos, reels and product CGI for any brand, and enforce that brand's guidelines automatically on every artifact.

plugins.name: claude-mem
plugins.description: Memory across sessions — remembers projects, files and context. REFERENCED, not vendored: it stays on its own release cadence and its author's licence, and a copy here would fork it silently.

plugins.name: claude-code-setup
plugins.description: Anthropic's official plugin that reads a codebase and recommends the hooks, skills, subagents and MCP servers worth adding. REFERENCED, not vendored, for the same reason.
